'''Zeshatt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] leader of the [[White Maw]] pirates on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was killed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sergeant [[Fideltin Rusk]] during the latter incursion together with the [[Hero of Tython]] to the White Maw's base to retrieve a secret [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] databank.<ref name="The White Maw" />
